title: BBQ Chicken Quesadilla
reject_reason: BBQ-sauced chicken with cheddar in a tortilla is the same dinner as live bbq-chicken-burrito (chicken + BBQ + cheese + tortilla); quesadilla-vs-burrito is not a distinguishing plate, matching the prior buffalo-chicken-quesadilla ruling, and the single-serve format doesn't batch.
